notes.title: CUBERUN 1.3: INTERFACE UPDATE
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce the latest update for CUBERUN is here, packed with exciting new features to enhance your gaming experience! 🎉✨

In this update, we've listened to your feedback and made some exciting changes to the main menu. Prepare to be greeted by a fresh new background that sets the stage for your next adventure. Not only that, but we've also introduced a dynamic new camera angle that adds a whole new dimension to your menu navigation. 🌟📸

But that's not all – we've also revamped the buttons UI, making it easier than ever to navigate through the menus and dive into the action. With sleek new designs and improved functionality. And last but not least, get ready for a seamless experience as we introduce crossfade transitions between menus. 🔄🎵

Update now and dive into the enhanced world of CUBERUN! 🎮🔥

Made by: CubeStack Studios 🛠️🎮

notes.title: 🎉🎮 1 YEAR ANNIVERSARY 🎮🎉
notes.content:
Today marks a special milestone for us as we celebrate the anniversary of CUBERUN's release on Steam! It's been an incredible journey filled with challenges, updates, and most importantly, the unwavering support from our amazing community. 🚀💫

We want to take this moment to express our heartfelt gratitude to each and every one of you who has joined us on this adventure. Whether you've been with us from the beginning or just discovered CUBERUN recently, your enthusiasm and feedback have been invaluable in shaping the game into what it is today. 🙌🌟

Keep on running, and we'll see you around! 🏃‍♂️💨

notes.title: I am not dead!
notes.content: During a brief hiatus for necessary adjustments, we've been diligently crafting a website for CUBERUN, currently in the works. Excitingly, a forthcoming update for the game is on the horizon!

notes.title: CUBERUN 1.2: LEVEL UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello runners! This is the second update of the game. Is been a month since I release the first update, and the game is on a discount in this summer sale.
Added:
•Level menu page, now you can see all levels, locked and unlocked
Fixed:
•A problem with the background music in the levels
Removed:
•New and Load buttons, replaced with the Play button
Probably some progress will be lost since we change the New and Play buttons with the Play button. If you have some problems/bugs just report the problem to this email address: cuberun100@gmail.com.

notes.title: The First Update! CUBERUN 1.1 Sound Update
notes.content:
This is the first update of the game! This update is called Sound Update.
Added:
-Volume Slider, now you can edit the sound volume
-Main menu music
-Different music in levels (different from the main menu music)

I know this is a small update for begging,  but we will add more levels and achievements in the future. If you have some ideas or bugs to report just report them.
